newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 1.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 1.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* Composite Index of 100 blue chips lofted by month-end window dressing, rising 7.24 points or 0.68 percent to 1,077.30. But Monday volume very thin at 190 million.
"Yesterday was quite obviously window dressing," said the head of research at a local brokerage firm. "I don't think it will follow through today."
* Dow Jones slips 14.93 points to 7,672.79 after choppy session on Monday.
* Hong Kong market still closed for handover observances.
* Timber and gaming firm Repco says it has signed agreement to sell timber to construction firm Chase Perdana.

* Handful of results including tin-plater Perstima, posting 74.4 percent drop in full-year net profit to 3.59 million ringgit. The Store says year net profit dropped 42.6 percent to 10.84 million ringgit.
Kuala Lumpur Industries Holdings Bhd ended year with 11.76 million ringgit loss, versus 17.17 million ringgit profit. Its stock suspension has been extended by 10 trading days.
